name: Aurora Chronograph
shortDesc: A precision chronograph in brushed steel, built for everyday wear.
description: The Aurora Chronograph pairs a brushed stainless-steel case with a sapphire-coated crystal for everyday scratch resistance. Its tri-register dial and luminous hands keep it legible in low light, while a 100m water-resistance rating means it won't miss a beat by the pool or in the rain. A quiet, versatile piece that moves easily from the office to the weekend.

name: Meridian Classic
shortDesc: A classic leather-strap dress watch with a hand-finished dial.
description: Meridian Classic is built for the boardroom and beyond: a slim 38mm case, a sunburst dial finished by hand, and a genuine leather strap that softens with wear. The exhibition case back reveals the automatic movement inside — a small detail for anyone who appreciates the craft behind the face.

name: Solace Minimalist
shortDesc: A clean, minimalist face designed to go with absolutely everything.
description: Solace strips the watch face back to what matters: hour, minute, and a clean line of light. The interchangeable mesh band suits both a boardroom and a Saturday, and the domed crystal keeps the whole piece scratch-resistant for years of daily wear.

name: Celeste Rose
shortDesc: A rose-gold dress watch with a delicate crystal-set bezel.
description: Celeste Rose brings a warm rose-gold finish and a hand-set crystal bezel to a compact 32mm case. Designed to layer beautifully with other jewelry, it's finished with a fine-link bracelet and a secure double-push clasp for confident everyday wear.

name: Wanderlust Field
shortDesc: A rugged field watch built for travel and daily adventure.
description: Built to keep up, Wanderlust Field wraps a shock-resistant movement in a matte-finished case with a rugged canvas strap. A luminous dial and 200m water resistance make it as at home on a trail as it is on a red-eye flight.

name: Ember Mesh
shortDesc: A refined mesh-band watch with a soft champagne dial.
description: Ember Mesh softens a Milanese-style steel band with a warm champagne dial and slim gold-tone hands. The adjustable magnetic clasp makes it effortless to put on, and the low-profile case slips comfortably under a sleeve.

name: Voyager Dive
shortDesc: A 200m dive watch with a unidirectional rotating bezel.
description: Voyager Dive is rated to 200m with a unidirectional rotating bezel for tracking elapsed time underwater. A screw-down crown, thick sapphire crystal, and a stainless bracelet with a diver's extension make it as capable below the surface as it looks above it.

name: Luna Petite
shortDesc: A petite 28mm case with a mother-of-pearl dial.
description: Luna Petite's genuine mother-of-pearl dial shifts subtly with the light, framed by a slim 28mm case that suits a smaller wrist without feeling delicate. Twelve hand-set crystal markers stand in for numerals, keeping the face soft and understated.

name: Horizon Steel
shortDesc: An everyday steel watch with a clean three-hand layout.
description: Horizon Steel keeps things simple: a brushed 40mm case, a clean three-hand layout, and a solid-link bracelet built to last. It's the watch you reach for when you want something dependable that never feels out of place.
